**tron-code-review — separate review pass**

Reviewed `82d05e94bea0dda172c9d23a7b5f58e90a7d7f49` → `0ee8671d355863658bbf292a12e04a566ac1af29` against the actual target branch, `jhan-vnnik-1-layout`.

No verified source-code defect found in this pass.

- Traced query preparation, cached-key storage, score calculation, attention-weight calculation, value accumulation, and completion. Inspected software-only and FPGA-assisted paths. FPGA means the accelerator card.
- Inspected enabled and disabled builds, the runtime kill switch, full and partial pages, visibility and sliding-window boundaries, empty work, query-buffer reuse, and supported and rejected query types and head shapes. Batch classification and counter ownership remain on their existing paths.
- The dispatch test uses stand-in kernels and checks routing and query packing. It does not establish numerical correctness. The real-kernel identity test supplies separate numerical evidence. Claude's recorded wrong-panel mutation failed at token 16, then the restored test passed.

I inspected code and the recorded manual test logs. I did not build or rerun product tests. The known token-247 smoke difference remains disclosed and its forced-run diagnosis is pending. Insufficient data to confirm its cause. Mixed serving workloads were inspected in code, not newly exercised. The accepted CI exception in #4865 and deferred work remain outside this review's findings.

[Production dispatch](https://github.com/positron-ai/tron/blob/0ee8671d355863658bbf292a12e04a566ac1af29/h/tron/models/self_attention.hpp#L1537) · [Kernel identity test](https://github.com/positron-ai/tron/blob/0ee8671d355863658bbf292a12e04a566ac1af29/t/t_amx_numerics.cpp#L215)

**ben-review — separate review pass**

Reviewed `82d05e94bea0dda172c9d23a7b5f58e90a7d7f49` → `0ee8671d355863658bbf292a12e04a566ac1af29`.

No actionable finding under this skill.

The new kernel reuses the packed-key view and page accessor. The view keeps storage details out of the attention caller. The two query packers express different matrix layouts, so combining them would hide a meaningful distinction. The new kernel has four runtime arguments. The new packer has two. No changed interface adds a list longer than four parameters.

I found no missing shared concept that warrants a new abstraction within this change. This pass used source inspection, including existing callers and related types.

[Kernel interface](https://github.com/positron-ai/tron/blob/0ee8671d355863658bbf292a12e04a566ac1af29/h/tron/kernels/amx_attn_iface.hpp) · [Attention caller](https://github.com/positron-ai/tron/blob/0ee8671d355863658bbf292a12e04a566ac1af29/h/tron/models/self_attention.hpp#L1781)

**wade-code-review — separate review pass**

Short version: no verified source-code defect found. One description finding was corrected in the plain-English edit made with this review. The draft's automated test status is also made explicit.

Reviewed `82d05e94bea0dda172c9d23a7b5f58e90a7d7f49` → `0ee8671d355863658bbf292a12e04a566ac1af29`, including the full changed files, callers, tests, both commits, CI configuration, description, and all three paginated discussion endpoints.

**Description finding — the kill-switch comparison does not isolate the key reader's cost (check 6).**

The description called the measured throughput and first-token-delay differences “the cost of the reader against the kernel.” The switch also removes query packing and tile setup. Eligible pages switch both score calculation and weighted-value accumulation. The latter changes from the AMX matrix kernel to the vector path. This is a verified scope mismatch in the interpretation, not evidence of a code defect. [Query preparation](https://github.com/positron-ai/tron/blob/0ee8671d355863658bbf292a12e04a566ac1af29/h/tron/models/self_attention.hpp#L1537) · [Weighted-value AMX call](https://github.com/positron-ai/tron/blob/0ee8671d355863658bbf292a12e04a566ac1af29/h/tron/models/self_attention.hpp#L1809)

The replacement says: “This comparison measures the end-to-end effect of disabling the AMX page path in one binary.” The measured numbers are retained. Isolating reader cost would require timings for score calculation separately from preparation and weighted-value accumulation.

**CI clarification (check 7).** CI means the automated build and test system. GCP Nix skipped this draft's product build and tests in [run 38162703366](https://github.com/positron-ai/tron/actions/runs/38162703366). The description now distinguishes that result from the placeholder cases that its default test configuration would execute. This does not reopen the accepted exception in #4865.

The remaining applicable checks found no new actionable issue. The numerical test, dispatch test, and type-boundary checks cover distinct contracts. The recorded deliberate panel-address error makes the identity assertion fail. The two commits are topical. No unrelated source change, new debug switch, or new asynchronous buffer owner was found.

Validation: I ran the whitespace/error check on the exact base-to-head diff and inspected recorded build, unit-test, mutation, smoke, and measurement results. I did not rerun product tests or sanitizers. The recorded host suite includes one skipped test and one known environment failure. The token-247 diagnosis remains pending. No merge approval is implied.
